meta_description:
3,661 likes, 247 comments - ishaanarora1 on June 29, 2024: "Ufff finallyyyy!! 🌚❤️ This might not sound believable but hear me out -

INSTAGRAM WAS THE LAST PLATFORM ON MY LIST WHEN I STARTED MAKING CONTENT!

It went like 
Quora then LinkedIn then YouTube and then Instagram.

I was super happy with my growth here but I always loved long form content because of the value it provides ❤️
Sadly LinkedIn and YouTube never grow at the same pace as IG. I didn’t celebrate 100,200,300K on IG but getting this play button means a lot to me ❤️

Making those 15-20 mins long videos sharing my experiences and then making people subscribe to it, makes me feel the best!! 

DEDICATED TO PROVIDING MORE SUCH CONTENT FOR YOU ALL BABIESSSS 😍❤️❤️

P.S -
1. Pls ignore the hair on my hand, drop in some cool waxing parlors 😂😂
2. I recd it almost 2-3 months back but couldn’t post it yet, jeez times have been busy but broooo it still feels so good.

Signing off (only to post again in the evening XD)
Ishhhhhh 🌚❤️

#youtube #growth #instagram #insta #viral #socialmedia".
